description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Singed''' empowers himself for 25 seconds with [[File:Ability power icon.svg|15px|link=Ability power]] ability power, [[File:Armor icon.svg|15px|link=Armor]] '''bonus''' armor, [[File:Magic resistance icon.svg|15px|link=Magic resistance]] '''bonus''' magic resistance, [[File:Movement speed icon.png|15px|link=Movement speed]] '''bonus''' movement speed, [[File:Health regeneration icon.svg|15px|link=Health regeneration]] '''bonus''' health regeneration, and [[File:Mana regeneration icon.svg|15px|link=Mana regeneration]] '''bonus''' mana regeneration.
description.text: Active: Singed empowers himself for 25 seconds with  ability power,  bonus armor,  bonus magic resistance,  bonus movement speed,  bonus health regeneration, and  bonus mana regeneration.

description2.raw: During this time, ''[[File:Singed Poison Trail.png|20xpx|border|link=Singed#Poison Trail|An icon for Singed's ability Poison Trail]] [[Singed#Poison Trail|Poison Trail]]'' additionally applies [[File:Grievous Wounds icon.png|20px|link=Grievous Wounds|An icon representing the keyword Grievous wounds]] [[:Grievous Wounds|Grievous Wounds]] for 1 second, which refreshes every 0.25 seconds while the [[File:Poison icon.png|20px|link=Cassiopeia/LoL|An icon representing the keyword Poison]] [[:Cassiopeia/LoL|poison]] persists.
description2.text: During this time, Poison Trail additionally applies Grievous Wounds for 1 second, which refreshes every 0.25 seconds while the poison persists.
